speaker: Security
text: Clearance verified. Proceed to the simulation suite for calibration.

speaker: Simulation
text: Calibration sequence initiated. Moving targets live.

speaker: AION
text: Baseline reflexes nominal, Ghost-7. Proceed.

speaker: Simulation
text: Optics calibration. Hold your sight picture.

speaker: Simulation
text: Hardened profiles. Shields absorb body hits; weak points do not.

speaker: Simulation
text: Secondary weapon class. Confirm handling.

speaker: Simulation
text: Aerial profile. Stabilizer core exposed on the underside.

speaker: Simulation
text: Cover discipline. Live training rounds inbound.

speaker: Simulation
text: You were exposed. Resetting.

speaker: Simulation
text: No cover this time. Trust the shield, Ghost-7.

speaker: Simulation
text: Shield timing off. Resetting.

speaker: Simulation
text: Close-quarters profile. Staggered targets are open to a takedown.

speaker: Simulation
text: Profiles concealed behind hard cover. Use the uplink.

speaker: Simulation
text: Surveillance cone active. Stay out of it, or stay invisible.

speaker: AION
text: The cameras up here answer to the Directorate. Remember that.

speaker: Simulation
text: Detected. Return to the ramp.

speaker: AION
text: Combat suite calibrated. The Director's office has your assignment queued in the operations gallery.

speaker: AION
text: Assignment: personal briefing with the Director. Your clearance is elevated for the duration.

speaker: AION
text: Proceed to the antechamber. Biometric authorization will be required at the door.

speaker: AION
text: Welcome back, Ghost-7. Crown Sector is secure. The Directorate is expecting you.

speaker: AION
text: Report to security for access confirmation.

speaker: Crown News
text: Directorate approval holds at 91 percent. Lower-district curfew extended indefinitely.

speaker: Crown News
text: AION oversight credited with a fourteenth consecutive quarter without a Crown Sector incident.

speaker: Ops Monitor
text: Gallery feed just dropped. One-eight-zero milliseconds, all cameras.

speaker: AION
text: Correction. Feed continuity is nominal. No anomaly is recorded.
